Form title year 2017 is the form vintage, not the cycle. p5 is a 'Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts' sheet on which the filer wrote N/A across Column A - a DIFFERENT table (Column B is 'Year to Date'), not transcribed and never mixed with the standard Summary Page.
